Name: Stamina Master - Energy Regeneration and Drain Control
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[b][size=6][center]Stamina Master[/center][/size][center][/center]
Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/url]

Stamina Master[/b] is a highly configurable Stardew Valley mod that gives you precise control over stamina regeneration and drain reduction.

[size=5][b]Features
[/b][/size]
[b]Two Operating Modes:
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Constant Mode[/b] - Set fixed regeneration and drain reduction values that apply throughout the day
[/list][list]
[*][b]Adaptive Mode[/b] - Configure different stamina behavior for five time periods (6am-9am, 9am-12pm, 12pm-5pm, 5pm-12am, 12am-2am)
[/list]
[b]Stamina Regeneration:
[/b]
[list]
[*]Automatically restore stamina at your chosen interval (configurable from 1-60 seconds)
[/list][list]
[*]Set regeneration amounts from 0-10 stamina points per tick
[/list][list]
[*]Never exceed maximum stamina capacity
[/list]
[b]Drain Reduction:
[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduce stamina consumption from actions by 0-100%
[/list][list]
[*]Works instantly when performing stamina-draining activities
[/list][list]
[*]Refunds a percentage of stamina that would normally be lost
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41653/41653-1769385093-2077683138.png[/img]﻿
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41653/41653-1769385093-711100596.png[/img]


[b]Fully Configurable:
[/b]
[list]
[*]All settings accessible through Generic Mod Config Menu
[/list][list]
[*]Adjust regeneration frequency to control how often stamina restores
[/list][list]
[*]Fine-tune values for each time period in adaptive mode
[/list][list]
[*]No game restart required for configuration changes
[/list]

[size=5][b]Requirements
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional but recommended)
[/list]
[size=5][b]Configuration
[/b][/size]
Access the mod configuration through Generic Mod Config Menu to customize:

* Enable/disable debug display
* Switch between constant and adaptive modes
* Set regeneration frequency (how many seconds between stamina restoration)
* Configure constant mode values
* Fine-tune adaptive mode time periods with individual regen and drain settings

[size=5][b]How It Works
[/b][/size]
The mod operates on two separate systems:

* [b]Regeneration[/b] adds stamina at regular intervals based on your frequency setting

* [b]Drain Reduction[/b] immediately refunds a percentage of stamina when you perform actions

This allows you to balance stamina recovery and consumption to match your preferred playstyle, whether you want a subtle boost or significant stamina advantages throughout the day.
